feeds.title: DownshiftingPRO
feeds.description: A Canadian Lifestyle and Travel Blogger, Margarita is a mother of 3 teens & adult children. Her philosophy is to live with less... and travel more. DownshiftingPRO is a family, lifestyle and travel blog geared towards families with high school and university aged children. I also tackle life in midlife, dealing with our aging parents and finding a new independence to travel.

feeds.title: Diary Of A Toronto Girl
feeds.description: Howdy, friend! My name's Jessica and I'm the writer behind Diary of a Toronto Girl, one of Toronto's top lifestyle blogs. I started Diary of a Toronto Girl in the summer of 2015 to document my adventures with my friends. It's since become both a diary of my own life and a resource for all things lifestyle. I occasionally write about my other loves: fashion, beauty, travel, and food!

feeds.title: Casie Stewart
feeds.description: Casie Stewart is an award-winning content creator and expert in digital media. Documenting her life since 2005 via her blog 'This is My Life,' she's been at the forefront of brand storytelling through influencer marketing. Her blog covers travel, tech, and lifestyle, all with a bright, sunshiney attitude.

feeds.title: Trisha Enriquez Blog
feeds.description: My name is Trisha Enriquez, I'm a Pre- and Post-Natal Fitness Specialist and a certified post-natal yoga instructor. Here I'm sharing all things health, fitness, motherhood, and lifestyle. I hope to inspire you to be happier and healthier through my words, photos, and workouts.

feeds.title: Little Miss Ottawa

Her mission is to live every day like a traveler and inspire her audience to embrace everyday adventures whether it's at home or abroad. Inspired by her exchange to Australia, Julia started her blog Little Miss Ottawa as a way to share all of her travels.

feeds.title: Sparkles Shiny Love
feeds.description: sparkleshinylove is a lifestyle blog for hip urban moms. My name is Mandy and I'm from Whitby, Ontario Canada. I'm a fab mom to a toddler, a pretty ok wife, and on the side, I'm a blogger, fashionista, world traveler, food enthusiast, and occasional DIY maven. I'm often accused of being a shopaholic as well, but I wouldn't say that's a bad thing.

In 2018, I gave birth to a beautiful baby girl and will continue to share my experiences on this blog.

feeds.description: With her love of fashion, Filipa created her blog, 'Playing With Apparel' as an outlet to express her thoughts and ideas. feeds.title: Beckerman Blog

We hope to inspire.

feeds.title: Mani Jassal Blog
feeds.description: The Mani Jassal brand is a luxury evening wear and bridal brand from Toronto, Canada started by designer Mani Jassal in 2014. She aims to develop a community of women celebrating the multiple layers of their identity and upbringing.

feeds.title: Ghost Girl Goods Blog
feeds.description: It captures the movement of dance, the sounds of music, and my passion for Japanese culture and fashion in each and every garment. Our goal here at Ghost Girl Goods is to extend our outreach to a global audience, spreading positivity and joy through fashion and events. While doing so, we will spread the message that fashion is a means of expressing our true selves with no limits.

feeds.title: Forward Fashion
feeds.description: At FORWARD, we believe in the power of passion and purpose working together. As a cutting-edge publication in a dynamic city, we champion and spark innovation in fashion. We actively engage with the community, fostering a shared identity and providing a supportive platform for artists to express themselves through our daily online content.

feeds.title: Beauty Crazed
feeds.description: We love all things related to beauty! I, Lisamarie, would be the makeup/shoe expert and Christelle has just proclaimed herself the shoe/lingerie queen. So sit back and enjoy while two crazy girls share their insane love for all that in beautiful with you!

feeds.title: Mindful Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Mindful Beauty is a safe no judgement space for you to receive guidance towards skin and soul healing. Mindful Beauty's philosophy is to support your skin's natural ability to function while educating, simplifying, and empowering each individual client to become their own intuitive skin healers.

feeds.description: Beauty At Your Door offers you mobile spa services at the comfort of your home. Check out our latest news on services, tips and advice on beauty, makeup and more!

feeds.title: Cheekbone Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about our Indigenous roots, sustainability, and the beauty industry. feeds.title: Try Small Things

A lifestyle blog for foodies, readers and decor enthusiasts who love to discover and try small things.

feeds.title: The Pink Millennial
feeds.description: The Pink Millennial is a Canadian based Fashion, Beauty, and Lifestyle Blog originating in London, Ontario by Amber Desilets.

feeds.title: How to Survive Life in the Suburbs

feeds.title: La Petite Noob
feeds.description: I'm a Toronto-based bon vivant who has been sharing her life online since La Petite Noob's inception in 2013. This is a lifestyle blog situated in Toronto, Ontario, Canada discussing personal style, fashion, beauty, and culture.

feeds.title: Kassandra Kondo
feeds.description: A freelance writer and content creator sharing her love for fashion, home, travel, and most recently, parenting. Follow the blog Kassandra Kondo for all things fashion, food, travel, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Random Acts Of Pastel
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Alyssa, and I'm the blogger behind Random Acts of Pastel. Random Acts of Pastel (or RAOP for short) started out as a street art concept that I came up with to make the world around me a happier place. Surviving on a diet of mainly sugar, I delight in sparkly surprises and rarely remove my rose-tinted glasses. So come, gallop through the glitter with me.

feeds.title: Renee M LeBlanc
feeds.description: Hello friend, I'm so happy that you're here! I'm Renee, A lifestyle blogger living in the Toronto area with my family of seven. feeds.title: Mayahood Blog
feeds.description: Mayahood is the brainchild of Maya Fitzpatrick, a blog about parenting, blogging about the ups & downs of parenting. I'm a stay-at-home mom to three awesome, busy boys. feeds.title: House of Kerrs
feeds.description: Sonya is the Editor of the family + lifestyle blog, House of Kerrs, and Travel, Food & Lifestyle Writer. Raising four kids under 12 years old with her spouse just outside Toronto, ON, she shares her modern mom musings, content surrounding family travel, food + recipes, and anything that helps simplify the everyday, while navigating the beautiful chaos of large family living.

feeds.title: To Beauty 'n Beyond
feeds.description: Hi everyone. I'm Grieta and I come from an amazingly beautiful Northern European country - Latvia. I've been living in Canada since 2009. Wow, where did the time go?! This is my lifestyle blog where I share my passion for, mostly, beauty and skincare, along with a few other things close to my heart.

feeds.title: Sincerely Celine
feeds.description: Hey guys! I'm Celine, and welcome to my inclusive, creative and vibrant documented life surrounding all things beauty, skincare, travel, hiking, fashion, and so much more! This is where I'm going to share all of my experiences with you and give you an insider look into my life and journey as it unfolds.

feeds.title: Style Democracy Blog
feeds.description: Head to StyleDemocracy for Canadian news and updates on fashion, retail, shopping, beauty, and more. Our warehouse sales connect you with the brands you love. Find your favourite fashion brands and stay up to date on the latest retail news with Style Democracy.

feeds.title: The August Diaries
feeds.description: A visual diary where Jill Lansky shares her expert style tips and tricks, the latest trends, easy beauty tutorials, and travel guides. She empowers her readers to become the best version of themselves and use clothing as a means to gain confidence.

She favors practical and no-fuss styling, opting for minimal effort and maximum impact. Her favorite part of blogging is discovering and sharing beauty & style secrets.

feeds.title: Peace Love Jenny
feeds.description: My name is Jenny, Two years ago I decided to pursue my love of cooking, earning my Culinary Arts Certificate from George Brown College, and have been honing my skills as I travel around the globe taking cooking classes in every city I visit. In this blog, I talk about food and fashion.

feeds.title: Krystin Lee

I could have never imagined it would come so far!

feeds.title: Lisawei Blog
feeds.description: Lisawei is a fashion, beauty, and lifestyle blog. The author shares her point of view, guides, tips, and more. One can also shop, and read about fashion on a single platform.

feeds.title: Fashionnights

Taking you behind the scenes of Toronto's vibrant fashion industry from launches & runway shows, photoshoots, and previews to global fashion coverage and news, FASHIONIGHTS aims to be a destination site for those who want to know what's happening in fashion, now.

feeds.title: THE PREP GUY

feeds.title: The Minted Mama Blog

My interior design work has been featured in four national as well as international design publications, and I continue to reveal newly designed spaces right here on the blog.

feeds.title: Julianne Costigan Blog

Her passion is working with women of influence and empowering them to use style as a way to reach their goals and show the world what they are capable of achieving.

feeds.title: Luso Life
